entries.summary: Near-zero open-domain knowledge (SimpleQA 3.0 — vendor's own number). It will confidently invent facts it was never taught, even though it grounds provided text well (HHEM 3.7%).

mitigations.note: Feed it the facts and it behaves: its grounding is excellent. Never use it as an encyclopedia.
Web-search tooling covers the recall gap for current-events questions.

citations.title: Vectara HHEM leaderboard (grounding vs recall split)

entries.summary: 16K context window — a quarter of what 2025+ peers offer. Long documents and long agent sessions simply don't fit.

mitigations.note: Chunked retrieval keeps each request inside 16K.
For genuinely long context, pick a 128K model.

entries.summary: Benchmark scores flatter it: in longer interactive sessions it drifts off instructions and feels less capable than its numbers suggest.

mitigations.note: Use it for one-shot, well-specified tasks; restate constraints each turn in longer sessions.
